verdict.rationale: Weave's built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify live agent interactions, and you can define custom signals that tag agent turns. That is a form of continuous scoring on production traffic. However, the evaluation docs center on Dataset-based Evaluation objects, and no documentation shows scorers or LLM judges attached to run continuously on incoming production calls. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running scorers or LLM judges continuously on live traffic (sampling, filters, configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
Weave provides end-to-end observability to monitor agent behavior, out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
